description: Check whether the Edgegap agent skills installed in the developer's agent are the latest, and update them. Finds installs made with the skills CLI (user-wide or this project), the Claude Code plugin edgegap@edgegap, and skills copied by hand into an agent's skills folder, and compares each skill with the latest on GitHub. Without apply it only checks and changes nothing. With apply=true it rewrites hand-copied skills from the files bundled in this server, and runs each outdated install's own updater (npx skills@1.7.4 update for the Edgegap skills only, or claude plugin update) only when the operator started the server with EDGEGAP_ENABLE_SKILLS_UPDATE=1; otherwise it lists those commands for the developer to run. Ask the developer before applying. Skill text is never downloaded by this tool. The skills served by edgegap_get_skill need no update here.

apply.description: Run the updates for outdated installs. Omit or false to only check.

installed_versions.description: Skill name → version of skills you have loaded from somewhere this server cannot see, e.g. {"edgegap-unity": "0.1.8"}. The version is metadata.version in the SKILL.md frontmatter.

name: edgegap_update_skills
title: Check and update the installed Edgegap skills
